## What this is

A depth camera measures how far away each point in its view is. The robot uses one to find
people: the face tracker turns the head toward them, and the stage page draws the people dancing
in front of the robot as live skeletons.

Two cameras fit the role, and both are listed as optional parts in the
[Hardware BOM](../hardware-bom.md):

- the **Orbbec Femto Bolt**, a time-of-flight camera, which this mount is being designed for;
- the **Intel RealSense D415**, a stereo camera, which works today.

[Camera selection](../camera-selection.md) compares these and other cameras.
